metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (1 + sampled mean off-diagonal item-embedding cosine)/2, accumulated in float32. Null when fewer than two items can be sampled or the allocation expires before this probe. Approximately 0.5 for orthogonal vectors; directional alignment alone does not measure recommendation diversity or establish representation collapse.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-one-sampled-negative score over nonpadding sequence/positive/negative positions. Score-scale dependent; not full-catalog ranking quality.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of those sampled margins. Null when no valid positions were observed.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid sampled margins below zero; ties do not count. Depends on the loader's negative distribution.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid sampled margins below eps=0.5; changes under positive score rescaling.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Item categories are unavailable. Category lists remain empty; totals still count valid sampled positions.

history_perturbations.sample: Seed 42; up to 32 training users per dataset with at least eight interactions after truncating complete training histories to model.maxlen. No loader targets or held-out events reconstruct prefixes.
history_perturbations.groups: Recent means last ceil(n/4) positions. Recurrent means duplicate item ID or cosine >=0.5 to another prefix position using training-observed title/description TF-IDF. Lowercase Unicode-accent-stripped word unigrams of length >=2, min_df=1, max_features=20000, L2 normalization. Missing text provides no lexical match. Operational similarity does not establish shared intent.
history_perturbations.partition: Recent-only, recurrent-only, overlap, neither. At most two positions are deleted, retaining at least two interactions. Overlap is joint sensitivity; isolated_nonrecent compares nonrecent nonrecurrent targets with nonrecent recurrent controls.
history_perturbations.matching: Five independent control draws, without replacement inside each draw; reuse across draws is allowed. Recurrence, overlap and isolated contrasts exactly match relative-position quartile floor(4*i/n), elapsed-time bin <=7, >7-30, >30-180, >180 days or missing, training-frequency quartile and final-item status. Recent-only matches frequency quartile and recurrence status against nonrecent positions; recency, position and time remain inseparable. Infeasible strata are skipped without relaxation. Frequency uses all training interactions; saved quartile edges use right-sided assignment.
history_perturbations.operations: Compact deletion and left repadding using existing absolute model positions. Fixed-slot and final-position masking are unavailable without verified attention and readout semantics. Shuffle controls permute only nonpadding positions; one fixes the last item.
history_perturbations.candidates: One fixed full catalog minus ALL original observed training items per user, including truncated-away items. Removed items never become eligible. No validation/test events are consulted. Scores are chunked; descending score ties use ascending item ID.
history_perturbations.top10_disruption: 1 minus intersection(original top10, changed top10)/10. Excess subtracts the mean of five matched-control disruptions. This is sensitivity, not accuracy or a causal preference effect.
history_perturbations.original_top_displacement: Changed zero-based rank of the original top item minus its original rank, zero. Excess subtracts the matched-control mean.
history_perturbations.original_pair_gap_change: Change in score(original top item)-score(original runner-up), always on those same two items. Excess subtracts matched-control changes. Score-scale dependent; rank diagnostics are invariant to positive rescaling.
history_perturbations.aggregation: Average within user, then across users within the current dataset, with prefix-length strata 8-31, 32-63, 64+. Seed-42 percentile bootstrap with 500 user resamples; all controls stay with their user. Fewer than two users gives no interval. Intervals are descriptive, conditional on diagnostic completion, and do not cover training-seed variation or adaptive validation reuse.
history_perturbations.coverage: Attempted, empty, infeasible and completed counts are separate. Budget-interrupted users contribute no partial contrasts. Fine exact strata, particularly final-item matching, can make coverage sparse.
history_perturbations.selection: Supplementary full-catalog diagnostics never select checkpoints or modify the model. Four-dataset nomination needs external aggregation; no experiment or comparative validation result is fabricated. Budget-matched baseline/comparator trials and pinned macro HR@10 selection remain host orchestration responsibilities.

metric_definitions.diagnostic_runtime_seconds: Measured synchronized wall time on the single-GPU process; host must charge actual elapsed cost. When remaining budget is supplied, the predeclared allocation is min(60 seconds, 5% remaining), including preserved probes. Checks occur between batches/chunks; an in-flight operation can exceed the deadline and any overrun is reported. Without shared remaining-budget accounting, new perturbation scoring is unavailable.
metric_definitions.random_ranking_reference: Independent continuous random scores give expected pinned HR@10=0.10 for 100 candidates. This is a theoretical reference, not an observed metric.
metric_definitions.unobserved_information: No review content, ratings, item categories, prices, stores, ownership or simulator diversity/conformity traits are used or inferred.
